tooltip.robotica.signal_flare: Right-click a Colossus Altar to wake the Scrap Colossus
tooltip.robotica.signal_flare.details:
Altars stand in Rusted Foundry ruins (plains, deserts, badlands).
The Colossus always drops a Servo Core. Only real attacks hurt it.
One Colossus per altar, then the altar cools down (5 minutes by default).
tooltip.robotica.colossus_altar.details:
Use a Signal Flare on it to wake a Scrap Colossus on top.
Needs 3x3 blocks of air above it, 4 high.
Build a walled arena: the Colossus stays near its altar.
It cannot be mined while it cools down.
